step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays two parallel ingestion paths. Path 1: Sales data from an on-premises database passes through a VPN, is captured via DMS, and flows into Amazon Redshift, which connects to the S3-based Data Lake. Path 2: Flat files land in an S3 drop bucket, triggering an SQS message queue which invokes an initiator Lambda function. This Lambda queries metadata from DynamoDB and writes files to the Data Lake. A second processing Lambda is triggered by Data Lake S3 events to merge datasets and export the output back to the Data Lake and into Redshift for business users. All nodes represent physical icons on the board, and edges trace the physically drawn arrows.
